basic_info.description: When you only have time to see one of the best condominiums in the Candlestick Cove neighborhood...this one comes to mind because of its relaxing southern water and mountain views plus lush trees and bay trails throughout the waterfront and bordering Bayview Park. The condo has been fully updated and features a spacious layout with 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms on opposite sides, ensuring no shared walls.   The kitchen is equipped with all-new stainless-steel appliances, ample cabinetry and quartz countertops. Bright with water views can be seen from the private balcony, the living-dining great room, kitchen and primary bedroom suite. Those wishing to live in San Francisco for city delights but value a retreat "zen-like" atmosphere and the ease to commute to the South Bay/Peninsula - truly make this the best of both worlds here! This home also includes a large storage unit and 2 deeded parking spaces (next to the elevator), along with a generous closet and double vanity in the primary bedroom. As a bonus, this gated community offers 24/7 onsite security, a gym and a picnic area to enjoy the warm weather, views and an in-unit washer and dryer complete this move-in ready tranquil place to call home. Oasis awaits...stop looking & start living!
